slides.title: killed in a drone strike in Tigray, 2 of them children
Finarwa village, Oct. 20
slides.body: About 85 km southwest of Mekelle, AFP reported. Five more people were wounded.

slides.title: Goat traders hit
slides.body: A local priest, who asked not to be named, told AFP the drone struck traders loading goats onto a truck.

slides.title: Who carried it out?
slides.body: The report does not say who operated the drone. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Investigate every strike.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
